4946.title: The Swimming Pool
4946.overview: Set in a magnificent villa near a sun-drenched St. Tropez, lovers Jean-Paul and Marianne are spending a happy, lazy summer holiday. Their only concern is to gratify their mutual passion - until the day when Marianne invites her former lover and his beautiful teenage daughter to spend a few days with them. From the first moment, a certain uneasiness and tension begin to develop between the four, which soon escalates in a dangerous love-game.
4946.trailerName: La piscine | 4K restoration | Official trailer | Lumière

83282.title: Screamplay
83282.overview: A talented writer, Edgar Allen, arrives in Hollywood with big dreams but is quickly pulled into a world of madness and depravity. A detective investigating a series of murders discovers that they are similar to the murders that occur in the new script by Edgar. Who will survive and what parts will be left for them?

116370.title: Nothing But Time
116370.overview: The life of a great city (Paris) from dawn until dusk, including the beautiful and the ragged, the rich and the poor.

520274.title: Lamb
520274.overview: The traditional struggle, known as Lamb in Wolof, which recalls the Greco-Roman struggle, is a popular national sport in Senegal. It has special rules and very strict.  Every spectator can bet on his favorite wrestler in a festive atmosphere. The Dakar Arena serves as a showcase for the battles in the film.

592402.title: Great Bear Rainforest: Land of the Spirit Bear
592402.overview: Journey to a land of grizzlies, coastal wolves, sea otters and the all-white spirit bear - the rarest bear on earth - in the film Great Bear Rainforest. Hidden from the outside world, the Great Bear Rainforest is one of the wildest places left on earth. Found on Canada's remote Pacific coast, it is the last intact temperate rainforest in the world-a place protected by the region's indigenous people for millennia. Now, for the first time ever, experience this magical world in IMAX and giant screen theatres, and discover the land of the spirit bear.
592402.original_title: Great Bear Rainforest: Land of the Spirit Bear

651154.title: In a Whisper
651154.overview: An intimate and revealing autoethnographic documentary about uprootedness, motherhood, love of film, friendship and freedom.  Two filmmakers who have been best friends since childhood, both part of the Cuban diaspora, share their intimate and emotional journey while they try to find themselves and each other in a foreign land.

663250.title: Behind the Rain
663250.overview: A brutal sexual murder of a minor revolts the anger of the town. On the other hand, a psychologist, Sofia Belmar is not only shocked by the event, but this also brings back some of her more gruesome memories.

804370.title: Arco
804370.overview: Ten-year-old Arco lives in a far future. During his first flight in his rainbow suit, he loses control and falls into the past. Iris, a girl his age from 2075, comes to his rescue and tries by any means to help send him back to his own era.

947474.title: Born in the Jungle
947474.overview: During late 1950s in Venezuela, nine-year-old Elizabeth’s summer break takes a wild turn when her little brother Leo vanishes into the jungle. She must swap her books for bravery not only to find her brother but also to rescue a mystical furry animal from captivity and bring him back up to the legendary Tepui mountain.
947474.trailerName: Born in the Jungle (2026) - Official Trailer

1029906.title: Erratics
1029906.overview: Freeing himself after spending a hundred years trapped in a glacier, the ghost of the filmmaker Lucien Castelnau wanders through a futuristic Patagonia, where technological progress clashes with forgotten stories. Unable to rest while his cinematic legacy remains unseen, he crosses a world that has deleted him from its memory, in search of a place in history and of spectators, who can finally bring his lost work back to life.

1079314.title: On the Edge
1079314.overview: Alexia, 25, arrives as a trainee nurse in the closed ward of a psychiatric hospital, and meets Joëlle, the head nurse, who teaches her the job. Alexia is touched by the anger of Mila, a 20-year-old patient, who thinks she has no business being there. Despite Joëlle’s warnings about keeping her distance from patients, Alexia gets close to Mila and puts all her energy into trying to get her out.

1110034.title: Kraken
1110034.overview: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?

1141970.title: Morte Cucina
1141970.overview: Sao, a talented cook, accidentally meets the man who took advantage of her in the past. She sets her revenge plan in motion using her cooking skill to achieve a rather unexpected result.
1141970.trailerName: ครัวสาว Morte Cucina l Official Trailer

1164114.title: Beautiful Pain
1164114.overview: Niken (Raihaanun), a single mother going through a divorce from Dirga (Baim Wong), must find a job so she can gain custody of her child and support herself. Niken then lands a role in a movie and becomes popular. However, at the same time, she faces problems with the film crew and with her ex-husband, who is trying to take custody of their child away from her.

1181394.title: Wild Feast
1181394.overview: A wounded moose escapes its hunters, later dying deep in the forest and becoming... a communal feast. As the seasons go by, mammals, birds and insects invite themselves to the banquet - multiplying ensuing games, rituals and conflicts. In exploring and occasionally foiling nature's wildlife codes, our story becomes a simple yet poignant reflection on death, on its natural place in this world and, by extension, on its deeper meaning and purpose - important lessons to explore at this time when the glorious paradises offered by religions tend to feel less and less credible.

1196946.title: Ikkis
1196946.overview: Second Lieutenant and India's youngest Param Vir Chakra recipient, Arun Khetarpal, gave his life fighting for his battalion and the country during the 1971 Battle of Basantar. Ikkis also takes a reflective look at the futility of war through the eyes of Khetarpal's father, who visits his ancestral home in Sargodha and Alma Mater for reunion, which now happens to be in post-partition Pakistan, 30 years later.
1196946.trailerName: Ikkis - The Final Trailer | In Cinemas Worldwide This New Year | 1st January 2026

1198994.title: Send Help
1198994.overview: Two colleagues become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash. On the island, they must overcome past grievances and work together to survive, but ultimately, it's a battle of wills and wits to make it out alive.

1208274.title: Little Dreamerz
1208274.overview: Gun-woo, drowning in a failing business, meets Yo-sup, a mysterious boy who lives in dreams, and glimpses a future that lets him win big on a sports bet. While searching for Yo-sup again, he crosses paths with Min-a, a guarded high school girl. Struggling to understand one another, the three are drawn into a strange journey shaped by dreams and fate.

1225746.title: Fuse
1225746.overview: After two middle class teenagers commit a horrific crime, their parents debate whether they should protect their loved ones or let them face the consequences for their actions.

1226834.title: This Tempting Madness
1226834.overview: A young woman awakens from a coma grievously injured, memory fractured, her husband arrested. But as she puts together the pieces of her past, she starts to question her own actions — and her perception of reality.

1247058.title: Summer War
1247058.overview: The peaceful summer holiday of a US champion of the board game Third Reich is shattered when a tourist mysteriously disappears at sea.

1247890.title: Bird Flu
1247890.overview: An anxiety-ridden man’s decision to take in an injured bird leads to a deep reflection of his traumatic past and an intense physical transformation.

1262162.title: Lucky Weekend
1262162.overview: Over one weekend, 18 year-old Gabe finds out his best friend has stolen his winning lottery ticket and wrangles a group of unlikely buddies to help him retrieve it before it's cashed in.

1274706.title: The Marked Woman
1274706.overview: When a woman is found in a shipping container with no memory of who she is, two detectives race to figure out her identity — and who wants her dead.

1275090.title: Lost Chapters
1275090.overview: When Ena returns to Venezuela, after spending several years abroad, she discovers a postcard in her father's bookshop and sets off in search of a forgotten writer.

1290450.title: Love Me Tender
1290450.overview: At the end of summer, Clémence tells her ex-husband that she’s had relationships with women. Her life is turned upside down when he files to strip her of their son’s custody. Then begins a struggle of several years for Clémence to defend her right to be a mother and a woman – free to make her own choices.

1293202.title: Future Future
1293202.overview: In a rainy Brazilian city, an amnesic man is taken in by a lonely clickworker at a course for people with a strange neurological syndrome. After using an addictive AI device, he embarks on a tragic and absurd journey to find where he truly belongs.

1293266.title: Nightblade
1293266.overview: The Nightblade Killer is on the loose during the night of a full moon.

1301394.title: Regretfully At Dawn
1301394.overview: In a small province in Thailand, the life of the former Thai veteran, Yong, casually seems like a typical old man. Even though he currently feels unwell, Yong spends every day with the dream of building a tree-house solely with his own hand, and raising an intelligent niece.

1302994.title: Roma elastica
1302994.overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

1304530.title: Tell Everyone
1304530.overview: Amanda Aaltonen refuses to resign herself to the miserable fate of a poor woman and daringly seeks her happiness in the world. As punishment for breaking the rules, society deprives her of the most important thing of all, her freedom, and imprisons her on the island of Seili.

1305810.title: The Auction
1305810.overview: The film is set at Aztec Corp., a company that auctions off ancient antiquities and semi-distinct wild exotic animals.

1306322.title: Spaceballs: The New One
1306322.overview: Forty years after the events of the first Spaceballs, the galaxy is once again under threat. A threat so evil, so unstoppable, so completely lacking in any original ideas, that it has vowed to bring back the past... every last bit of it. With Lone Starr in hiding, Queen Vespa on the throne, and the Schwartz stretched thinner than a franchise releasing TV episodes theatrically, the only hope for the galaxy is Vespa's undisciplined son, Prince Starburst, and a mysterious Palace advisor named Destiny. Together, they must find Lone Starr, Yogurt, and any other iconic legacy characters fans are demanding before they discover the hard way that, while some threats you can fight, the reboot is not one of them.

1307474.title: On Behalf of My Son
1307474.overview: Vicentina struggles to cope with the death of her son Wesley after a tragic bus accident, in which he was the driver. As the investigation unfolds, evidence suggests that Wesley’s actions may have been suicidal. Vicentina then embarks on a journey to seek out the victims’ families and apologize, while confronting her own grief and uncertainty.

1308754.title: Johnny
1308754.overview: A biographical film that dramatizes the life of Jean-Philippe Smet, better known by his stage name Johnny Hallyday, a French rock and roll and pop singer and actor.

1320018.title: The Frog and the Water
1320018.overview: The cautious friendship between Stefan Busch, known to everyone as Buschi, and Mr. Hideo Kitamura begins on this special road trip. Buschi, who has refused to speak with his fellow human beings his entire life, blossoms on this journey to unknown places.

1320786.title: Terrifier 4
1320786.overview: The fourth installment in the Terrifier franchise. Plot TBA.

1341138.title: Spa Weekend
1341138.overview: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

1371730.title: Love Language
1371730.overview: Following a failed engagement, Lou discovers she has a talent for writing other people’s wedding vows. Word spreads across Chicago’s wedding scene and Lou’s services are in high demand. She even has a new admirer in Dash. But everything changes when she’s asked to write vows for Olivia, who’s marrying Warren, Lou’s old college flame.

1381202.title: The Outer Threat
1381202.overview: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

1382802.title: Family Movie
1382802.overview: The Smiths have gathered once again on their quaint family farm to make the latest in a string of low-budget horror movies. No, the movies aren't particularly "successful." Some might even call them "bad." But at least the family is together, and that's what matters to Jack and Ellen. Their adult children, on the other hand - Trent and Ula - are working up the courage to leave this particular family tradition behind. Simmering family dysfunction turns to pure chaos when a real dead body shows up on set. Can they come together to keep the movie on track, or will this be the Smith family's final act?

1390674.title: The Broken Arrow
1390674.overview: After his mentor’s death sends local darts champion Barry Barnes into a spiral of booze and self-destruction, a drunken accident costs him an arm. Now Barry must face his demons and take on his arch-rival, “Darts Vader,” for one last shot at glory.

1401106.title: Salvation
1401106.overview: In a remote village, an exiled clan returns, reviving a decades-old land feud. Seized by divine visions, Mesut challenges his brother’s leadership to save his people. Will this new path bring salvation or tragedy?
1401106.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 구원은 없다 Salvation | 월드 시네마

1431314.title: Underground
1431314.overview: 2060: In a dystopian future, a lonely mother faces an enormous dilemma when she has to choose between protecting her son, persecuted by an oppressive system, and maintaining her own moral principles.

1437970.title: Azza
1437970.overview: Determined to make her own money, Azza teaches other women as a freelance driving instructor. Behind the wheel of her big black Toyota, she feels safe, proud – and free. She speeds down the country’s roads and highways. From the city to the endless desert, nothing can stop her.

1439698.title: Dorian Gray, or Narcissus Through the Looking Glass
1439698.overview: Dorian Gray is but a boy, yet he's worshipped as a God - by the closeted painter who immortalized his beauty, by the libertine who taught him all of the world's secret pleasures, and by himself. For the next one hundred years, Dorian Gray falls into a rabbit-hole of debauchery, remaining forever young while his portrait pays the price for each of his sins. But when crimes of decades past come back to haunt him, and the novelty of everlasting youth starts taking its toll, can his soul still be redeemed?
1439698.original_title: Dorian Gray, ou Narciso Através do Espelho

1440978.title: Retrieving Roadie
1440978.overview: It’s just another dull business trip for a lonely pet food salesman until he rescues a dog who could change his life – if they survive a harrowing journey home.

1452242.title: Drei Kameradinnen
1452242.overview: Hani, Kasih and Saya have shared a deep friendship since their youth. Now, after years, the three meet again. But no matter where they are, it becomes clear time and again that everyday racism affects their lives. Nonetheless, their friendship gives them strength. Until one dramatic night shakes everything up.

1453778.title: Tokyo Burst: Crime City
1453778.overview: Rookie detective Aiba, a native of Tokyo's red-light district (with all the attitude and methods that entails), must team up with Cho, a counterpart from Seoul with equally questionable practices, to track down a dangerous criminal spreading terror across Japan, Korea, and the Philippines. While the relationship between the two investigators is frosty at first, they'll have to learn to work together quickly in the face of such a formidable adversary.

1458578.title: Nexus: 3001
1458578.overview: After the fall of Earth at the hands of its own creators, the remnants of humanity seek refuge on Nexus, a red planet where hope once thrived. Now, it endures under the rule of Kovino, the God whose authority is absolute and unquestioned. As quiet whispers of an old prophecy begin to resurface among the people, speaking of their savior named Wadha. As a reluctant rebel named Eli finds himself drawn toward a decision that may disturb the fragile order and set something far greater into motion for their savior to return.

1469458.title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu
1469458.overview: Three Kerala Police officers venture into a mysterious forest on the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border to find a missing officer. They encounter strange time-related phenomena, uncovering the hidden secrets of Velloorkkatt forest.

1470034.title: Oasis
1470034.overview: When a viral video of a student threatening his classmates surfaces online, the school spirals into escalating violence. Crushed by the pressure of teachers and parents, three outcasts take refuge in a nearby forest. There, play hardens into ritual and pain becomes an escape, until old wounds surface and the boundaries between them are redrawn.
1470034.trailerName: BIFF2026 Trailer | 오아시스 Oasis | 플래시 포워드

1485138.title: Inside That House
1485138.overview: After a number of strange disappearances have been reported in the area, Andrew and Jason, two brothers who received a drone for graduation, decide to film around their town to learn more about them, but then become distracted by a new girl in school who lives nearby. The two boys devise a plan to sneak their drone through an open window of her home, only to discover a terrible, dark secret.

1493010.title: Quasi Vera
1493010.overview: Diego is an aspiring actor struggling to find his place in the world amidst failed auditions and bit parts as an extra. When his personal life hits a crisis, he is forced to reinvent himself. An encounter with the world of influencers and new technologies offers him an unexpected opportunity: leveraging his IT skills and artificial intelligence, he creates Vera—a beautiful, captivating, and seemingly perfect virtual influencer. Through a unique blend of wit, sensuality, and iconic goals scored by the Italian national team, Vera rapidly gains millions of followers, transforming into a media phenomenon.

1503058.title: Se não eu, quem vai fazer você feliz?
1503058.overview: The plot is based on the book "Se Não Eu, Quem Vai Fazer Você Feliz? – Minha História de Amor com Chorão" (If Not Me, Who Will Make You Happy? – My Love Story with Chorão). The film explores the rise of Charlie Brown Jr. and Chorão’s journey in Santos—spanning the worlds of skateboarding and the stage—while focusing intimately on the intense, nearly 20-year romance between the musician and Graziela, revealing the man behind the idol and the creative process behind the band's greatest hits.
1503058.original_title: Se não eu, quem vai fazer você feliz?

1503762.title: Sense and Sensibility
1503762.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

1516818.title: Happy Hours, Part 1
1516818.overview: Two people navigate their relationship within the challenges of careers and family responsibilities and the pursuit of love, despite life’s inevitable obstacles. A character-driven dramedy that explores the emotional journey of young loves who reconnect as adults, with the connective thread of shared joys, loss, and hope. Part one of a trilogy.

1533842.title: Umka
1533842.overview: Live action adaptation of the soviet cartoon shorts Umka (1969) Umka ishchet druga (1970)

1541074.title: Honestino
1541074.overview: Arrested five times for his activism, student leader Honestino Guimarães was kidnapped in 1973 at the age of 26 and is one of the hundreds of people who disappeared during the Brazilian military dictatorship.

1541138.title: McCartney: The Hunt for the Lost Bass
1541138.overview: For over fifty years, the disappearance of Paul McCartney’s original Höfner bass has been one of rock ‘n’ roll’s enduring mysteries. The Hunt for the Lost Bass tells the extraordinary story of this iconic instrument, and the fan powered quest to find it.
1541138.trailerName: McCartney: The Hunt for the Lost Bass (2026) | Official Teaser

1541330.title: Stuffed
1541330.overview: Araminta, a brooding, dubiously ethical taxidermist, secretly desires to stuff a human specimen. She finds her perfect match in Bernie, a sandwich factory worker whose life is all but memorable. The two decide to go ahead with the plan, but not before they find each other (and various other dead things) in the process.

1552274.title: Okay
1552274.overview: Struggling with the loss of her husband, a widow processes her grief by searching for him amidst the cosmos.

1555218.title: Are We Monsters?
1555218.overview: A gay radical outsider, a flamboyant Muslim, and a nasty single mom live in a devout Muslim area on the Thai border under decades of martial law.

1555986.title: Mira
1555986.overview: Mira, a twelve-year-old girl, loves to make arts of recycled trash and spends hours together with her best friends Naja and Louis. One day everything changes when Naja becomes best friends with the new cool girl in class. Suddenly Mira feels left out and starts to wonder if she can stay true to herself, when everything and everyone around her seem to be changing. Should she skip her upcoming arts exhibition and instead try to be more like the other girls in class, talking about love and falling in love? Growing up can be a challenge sometimes…

1560850.title: Full Moon Rising: The Charles Band Story
1560850.overview: A brand new feature documentary about the incredible life and career of prolific film producer and director Charles Band.

1562642.title: Ghost Soldier
1562642.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

1563282.title: Land van Johan
1563282.overview: In 1969 Amsterdam, two idealistic roommates fall for the same free-spirited young woman, pulling them into a heady world of hippie dreams, artistic rebellion, and emotional turmoil that tests their friendship and the ideals of free love.

1564818.title: Siti Vampire
1564818.overview: Siti is an ordinary girl who accidentally turned into a vampire due to a strange incident. She is trapped at the age of 25 forever, along with all her problems. Siti must find a way to cure herself and return to being a normal human being.

1568210.title: What Remains
1568210.overview: A couple in the late stages of pregnancy come face to face with a physical manifestation of their grief.

1568978.title: LEGO Wonder Woman: Swan Song
1568978.overview: Wonder Woman, Donna Troy and Hawkwoman clash with Doctor Pyscho and The Silver Swan, who is a ghost from Diana's past.

1575826.title: Loss of Altitude
1575826.overview: Where do we go when everyone wants their country back? A film about collective guilt and what remains between two people when an entire nation looks away.

1583250.title: Untitled A24 Horror Film
1583250.overview: A bachelor party spirals into terror.

1588626.title: In a Holidaze
1588626.overview: After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, an aimless twentysomething finds herself trapped in a holiday time-loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy.

1589906.title: UFC 325: Volkanovski vs. Lopes 2
1589906.overview: UFC 325: Volkanovski vs. Lopes 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 1, 2026, at the Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, Australia.
1589906.trailerName: UFC 325: Volkanovski vs Lopes 2 Narrated By Robert Whittaker

1595346.title: Zi
1595346.overview: In Hong Kong, a young woman haunted by visions of her future self meets a stranger who changes the course of her night -- and possibly her life.

1595538.title: The Last Goodbye
1595538.overview: When you own a non-denominational funeral parlour. When you’ve lost your driver’s license for drinking too much. When you fall in love with an office trainee 25 years your junior. When your daughter begins to understand that you’re not the father she thought you were. When the retired boxer who lent you money is on your back. When death seems more interesting than life... What could go wrong?

1596306.title: Kikuyu Land
1596306.overview: As a Nairobi journalist probes a land battle entangling the local government and a powerful multinational corporation, covered wounds are revealed and family secrets are exposed.

1597138.title: The Fields of Abbottsville
1597138.overview: In Ohio, late 2004, after a young religious fanatic Joshua Tinsman (Brennan Abbott) celebrates his 18th birthday. He is then forced into committing crimes by his preacher Ron Tinsman Jr. (Aaron Hickman) that he doesn't want to follow through on. Years of indoctrination and influence from his friends discourages him from leaving. After all, it's the ideology that he and his childhood friend Stephen grew up with since birth. How can you leave something you spent your whole life working towards? Loosely based on a true story.
1597138.trailerName: The Fields Of Abbottsville (Proof Of Concept)

1597970.title: Tosnos
1597970.overview: Tosnos (তছনছ) is a Bangladeshi Action, Thriller, Mystery film directed by the acclaimed Badiul Alam Khokon. Produced by Munna Khan Multimedia, this cinematic venture stars Munna Khan and Eamin Haque Bobby in the lead roles, alongside powerful supporting performances from veteran actors Misha Sawdagor and Deepa Khandakar. The story is written by Kamal Sarker. This high-stakes thriller is set to explore a gripping narrative of power, corruption, and revenge.
1597970.trailerName: TOSNOS (তছনছ) Official Teaser |  Munna Khan | Bobby | Badiul Alam Khokon | New Bengali Movie 2026

1598802.title: Primal Darkness
1598802.overview: Cole Harrington, the host of a popular outdoor series, sets out to track down the predator responsible for a series of cattle attacks in rural Nevada. The mystery deepens when he uncovers footage depicting the final moments of two missing university employees.

1598866.title: Callback
1598866.overview: Max arrives home to find that his boyfriend has booked a callback. All hell breaks loose.

1600338.title: Almost Us
1600338.overview: RR has always been in love with his best friend, Janine. But she's infatuated with Kenzo, the star of her own fan fiction. When he finds a way for Janine to meet Kenzo, will he risk his own happiness just for her to have her own happiness?
1600338.trailerName: ALMOST US | Official Trailer — May 6, 2026 in Cinemas! | Fyang Smith and JM Ibarra #JMFyang

1607634.title: Anbe Diana
1607634.overview: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.
1607634.trailerName: Anbe Diana Trailer | Pari Elavazhagan, Ramya Ranganathan, Roja | Bharath Sankar

1607762.title: Honey
1607762.overview: A broken family, a forbidden ritual, and a child trapped between reality and delusion. Honey exposes systemic abuse and spiritual madness, where the most terrifying monsters are painfully real.

1612434.title: TWIN
1612434.overview: Fresh out of prison for murder, a ruthless woman schemes to replace her twin sister and claim her flawless life by any means necessary.

1613650.title: El fantasma de mi mujer
1613650.overview: Fernando's perfect life with wife María and mistress Julia shatters when Julia claims she accidentally killed María. After reporting María missing, Fernando receives a call from her - and his nightmare begins.

1616146.title: The Lights, They Fall
1616146.overview: Sixteen-year-old Ilay drifts through the summer on the outskirts of Berlin while a palliative nurse accompanies his ailing mother during her last days.

1617234.title: The Actor
1617234.overview: A young actor attempts to finish their self audition tape. But a series of never ending interruptions sends him into an existential spiral.

1617810.title: Ice Twister
1617810.overview: A family in a mountain cabin faces a deadly ice tornado that blocks escape routes. As the storm tears apart their shelter and tensions rise, they must choose between braving the elements or staying put to face the natural disaster from hell.

1621266.title: Loved One
1621266.overview: Sandy's compulsive need to save her eldest daughter Jess collides with her responsibility to celebrate her younger daughter's college graduation, forcing her to confront the line between love and obsession.

1621394.title: Sirena
1621394.overview: Micaella Raz ignites the screen as she plays a mythic siren who feeds on sexual energy, draining men in exchange for prosperity. A fisherman accidentally caught her and offers himself. When his wife learns the truth, she too makes a sacrifice for the sake of their family.

1621842.title: Bebe Main Badmash Banuga
1621842.overview: A gangster-in-training kidnaps the daughter of a prominent businessman in an attempt to win his boss' favour, but gets caught up in a web of deceit and conflict.
1621842.trailerName: Bebe Main Badmash Banuga (Trailer) Jagjeet Sandhu - Aveera - Releasing 06-Feb-26

1622226.overview: When a brother and sister are reunited after years of separation, they uncover a dark secret about one of the worlds largest pharmaceutical companies. Eager to expose the truth, they have no choice but to face their darkest fears together.

1624274.title: Aaram
1624274.overview: Aaram is a gripping crime thriller that explores the fragile line between integrity and survival. Rooted in emotional realism and layered with investigative tension, the film unravels the psychological turmoil of an honest police officer trapped in a web of guilt, fear and moral conflict. With elements of suspense, human drama, and institutional power play, Aaram promises an intense cinematic experience.

1625362.title: Holy Wood Dust
1625362.overview: Every winter, millions of fir trees are chopped down, admired, and thrown away. The film follows their journey above and below ground, from human rituals to the hidden life inside the trees. A story about trees that we celebrate by cutting them down.

1626066.title: Sutera Di Balik Purnama
1626066.overview: Melanie built a wall around her heart after the death of her fiancé, a loss that also shattered her faith in destiny. When her mother passed away and left a will instructing her to manage the traditional kebaya shop on Jonker Street, Melanie accepted it with a rebellious heart. Her plan was simple: destroy the business and walk away from everything.

1628882.title: Shabara

1628882.trailerName: Heartbeat Of Shabara Telugu Teaser - Dheekshithh Shetty | Misha Narang | Kilaru Prem Chand

1630354.title: Knock
1630354.overview: Facility No. 6, a juvenile protective detention center, stands on the verge of closure. A documentary crew steps inside to record what little remains, and from the moment the cameras turn on, they find themselves before long-buried wounds and truths no one has wanted to face. In the worn faces of teachers who have spent themselves caring for these children, and beneath the indifference of a society that has long since turned its head away from the other side of the wall, the crew quietly bears witness to how children with nowhere left to go have arrived at this place.

1631314.title: You Are the Film
1631314.overview: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

1631506.title: La ahorcada
1631506.overview: Rosa Martín, a singer-songwriter known as La Ahorcada, takes her own life in the garden of the man she loved, Fran, who treated her as nothing more than a sexual object. The ghost of La Ahorcada remains in Fran's mansion, refusing to be ignored and determined to teach him a lesson. Her obsession will end up turning the lives of Fran and his family into a living hell.
1631506.trailerName: LA AHORCADA. Tráiler oficial. 24 de abril en cines.

1649874.title: Deewana
1649874.overview: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

1652306.title: Капитан Невельской и земли Чёрного дракона
1652306.overview: Captain Gennadiy Nevelskoy, an excellent student at the Naval Academy, is forced by his talent to teach naval science to the Tsarevich instead of conquering distant seas, watching as other people's dreams replace his own. Fourteen-year-old Nadezhda, a young student at the Institute for Noble Maidens, has never found her place in the capital. Deep down, she knows her true home is lost somewhere in the lands of the Far East, and she must return there. Upon meeting each other, Gennadiy and Nadezhda embark on a great and dangerous adventure-a search for themselves and their place in the world.

1652946.overview: Finally at the hospital for his long awaited gender affirming top surgery, Matt Levit, with lively girlfriend Leisha Meyer by his side, navigates the bureaucracy of the top surgery process. But once Matt is thrown deep into surgery day, he suddenly finds his present intertwining with his past self, Kimberly. Plunging through past and present, Matt is dropped into confronting his relationship with his chest and sudden loss of his mother, Nancy.

1653842.overview: In a surreal journey of self-discovery, a man serving twins in a luxurious mansion confronts the unknown world hidden behind the conditioning. He outplays them and embarks on a symbolic odyssey through a magic orchard, the world around him decays into fading echoes of meaning—revealing renewal within the ruins of universal self.

1656018.title: Michael Jackson: A Life in Music

1656018.original_title: Michael Jackson: A Life in Music

1667474.title: Wolf Hunters 2

Deep in the dense jungle, they engage in a tense manhunt and fierce confrontations with the cartel leader Jiede. After a life-and-death struggle in the wilderness, they ultimately succeed in safeguarding national security.

1668178.title: Ram Naam Satya
1668178.overview: A high-stakes story with the theme of justice, retribution, and conflict, characterized by intense action sequences.
1668178.trailerName: RAM NAAM SATYA || Movie Official Trailer 2026 || Biraj Bhatta, Sunil Thapa, Sushil, Aayush, Supuspa

1669010.title: Stolen Memories
1669010.overview: 18-year old Emil's night takes a dark turn when a break-in reveals old photographs of Emil and his mother in a bathtub, making him question his past.

1669970.title: After Hours
1669970.overview: Two brothers trapped in poverty gamble on day trading as ambition turns to addiction. When one final all-in bet collapses, their home becomes a pressure cooker where love, pride, and survival collide.

1674258.title: Frampton
1674258.overview: Follows a rock icon who lost everything and fought his way back, again and again.

1675218.title: Sara Bareilles: Good Grief
1675218.overview: Seven years after her Grammy Award-winning “Amidst the Chaos”, Sara Bareilles reunites with her closest collaborators to record a new album. What emerges is an intimate, cinematic process that lays bare the musician's deep connections and inspirations in  Josh Alexander's moving music documentary.

1676498.title: The Gymnasts of Fisherman Colony
1676498.overview: The birth of a gymnastics team in Pakistan provides an inspiring spark of light for a small group of girls on the margins.

1677586.title: Abandonados
1677586.overview: Abandonados, a case by Carles Porta, revisits one of the most unsettling episodes in recent Spanish history. Forty years after being abandoned at a train station in Barcelona, three siblings embark on an investigation to uncover their identity and their past. Through testimonies, archival material, and a long-term investigation, the work reflects on memory, identity, and the search for truth.

1686162.title: MKO
1686162.overview: Moshood Abiola wins Nigeria's freest election, only for the military to jail him. When U.S. diplomats arrive to negotiate his release, he is served tea, and dies.

1688402.title: KPOP Smoothie
1688402.overview: A broke Korean American student walks into a KPOP themed smoothie store and unknowingly orders a overpriced smoothie.

1690834.title: Lonely Road
1690834.overview: We follow the day to day life of Rylee, a girl navigating the harsh realities of homelessness and addiction. Every choice becomes a matter of survival-forcing her into situations no one should have to face as she struggles to find money, meaning, and a way forward.

1691986.title: DAWN PLAN
1691986.overview: In 1948, to secure victory in the Crossing-the-Yangtze Campaign and stabilize the newly-born people's regime, the Third Field Army selects outstanding officers to infiltrate Nanjing, the stronghold of Kuomintang rule. With strong support from the Nanjing underground organization of the Communist Party of China, they venture deep into the enemy's lair, engaging in a life-and-death struggle of wits and prowess against the Kuomintang reactionaries.

1693906.title: Behind Bars - Shot in the Spotlight

1695378.title: Okanjuwa
1695378.overview: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.

1695762.title: Deadbeat Boyfriend
1695762.overview: Ana is a college student with a dark secret: her boyfriend is a zombie. After his tragic death 3 months prior, she used ancient magic to reanimate his body. But as the relationship decays and a love between Ana and her roommate grows, Ana must choose: stay in a dead relationship, or take a chance on the living?

1696146.title: Staubwelt
1696146.overview: An elderly crime investigator has reached the end of her career. Shortly after stepping down, she encounters the Devil, who has appeared in the city and begun working as a police photographer. During a series of walks together, a warmth develops between them. Over the course of their conversations, the Devil reveals he needs her help to end his own existence.

1696274.title: The Last Show
1696274.overview: After receiving a mysterious video showing a deadly talk show, investigator Chris Lynch, sets out to discover the truth behind it. In doing so he gets trapped in the show and has his psyche pushed to the limits. His only hope being his connection to his partner Sarah.

1698450.title: Reflections
1698450.overview: A synchronized swimming coach and her daughter prepare for an important performance as the girl struggles more and more under the mounting pressure. When the coach's ex-husband, the club president, asks for their daughter to step back, it becomes clear how far they are willing to go for their dreams.

1699602.title: Sleeping Beauty
1699602.overview: After a long separation, a young soldier and his sister are reunited under the full moon. This fragmentary fable is enough here to open up a cinematic universe in enchantingly composed vignettes: High-contrast chiaroscuro – an artistic technique that uses strong contrasts between light and shadow to create depth, volume and dramatic moods – frames the enigmatic figures.

1700690.title: Autumn 2026
1700690.overview: In the latest edition of his poetic series, Wojciech Sobczyk reimagines our ideas and fantasies about this season to create a captivating, sensual, and at times unsettling audiovisual poem. From images of the changing autumn landscape, the animator extracts a universal tale of human nature and man’s place and role in the world.

1703058.title: Supplies
1703058.overview: Some time after the outbreak of a global pandemic that turned humans into mindless, terrifying monsters, two young survivors bound together by a necessary need for survival flee their homes in search of safety.

1709266.title: Love Whisper
1709266.overview: set against dreamy summer nights, camcorder footage, and coastlines, “Love Whisper” captures the quiet ache of longing, youth, and the moment every love song finally starts to make sense.

1709394.title: Pushers
1709394.overview: William and Birk are two first-year high school students, eager to experience everything youth has to offer. In an attempt to get noticed, Birk proposes a bold strategy: selling cocaine. With dreams of status, parties, and romance, their friendship is put to the test.

1710034.title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
1710034.overview: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.
1710034.trailerName: Afreet – A Never Ending Night | Official Trailer

1715282.title: Death by Roux
1715282.overview: A married couple throws a dinner party for their neighbors, with a special gumbo recipe on the menu.

1715410.title: Encounter and Farewell
1715410.overview: [EN] When his estranged father is hospitalized near the end of his life, a son ends up caring for the man who never cared for him, forcing them into an intimacy they have never known. [PT] Depois de uma vida inteira distante, um filho se vê, de repente, responsável por cuidar do pai, já nos últimos meses de vida. Na rotina de um quarto de hospital, o cuidado aproxima dois homens que nunca aprenderam a ser pai e filho.

1716370.title: 7 Piano Sketches
1716370.overview: A piano tuner wanders through the streets of New York after dark, seeking artistic inspiration. Sketchbook in hand, he observes the city’s lovers, mourners, and giant ants from afar. But when a twist of fate brings him face-to-face with a kindred spirit, he finds what he was looking for all along.

1716946.title: Void
1716946.overview: A man falls into a void and must return to the light.

1718546.title: Eclosión
1718546.overview: In a forgotten laboratory, a brilliant but obsessed inventor brings to life his most promising creation: the Hatchling. Fragile yet full of promise, the creature becomes the focus of both care and experimentation. As the line between legacy and control begins to blur, Eclosión explores the price of perfection and whether love can survive obsession.

1718930.title: Wandance
1718930.overview: Kaboku has always just gone with the flow, marching in step to the drumbeat of the expectations of those around him: parents, school, plans for the future. It feels predictable, safe, and… empty. But one night, Kaboku's at school late, and he happens on a girl alone, moving wildly, turning a blank space of concrete into a canvas. This is Hikari Wanda, a member of the hip-hop dance club. Kaboku is immediately smitten, but the road to stepping out of his shell is a long one. The club is almost entirely girls, and they're all, well, way better than him. What's ahead is unknown, and that's terrifying, but it also means, for the first time in Kaboku's life… a taste of freedom.

1719826.title: Tiny Rejections
1719826.overview: Taylor and her friend try to climb a fence at night but something looms in the shadows.

1720914.title: Their Depreciation
1720914.overview: As light floods his apartment and the sounds of the outside world grow louder, a solitary figure withdraws into himself. The sight of a photo of his friends triggers an existential crisis that leads him to question his own worth. Their Depreciation tells the story of this slow struggle with self-esteem and a sense of insignificance.

1721938.overview: A short film about the emotions and memories we associate to our personal belongings.

1722322.title: Mamsaharam

A dark psychological study of addiction and escalating obsession, as a man ultimately becomes what he consumes.
1722322.trailerName: Mamsaharam - Trailer | Award Winning Short Film | Psychological Horror | Thriller | 26th June 2026

1725330.title: Mixed Sauna

His spouse Hanna is certain that Mikko will make a great first impression on her chosen family, the three friends that they are hosting.  When it’s time for the sauna Mikko has not, despite all his attempts, figured out the sauna dress code of this new social bubble. As he steps into the sauna, Mikko realizes he’s the only one wearing swimwear—everybody else is naked. This traumatising event causes mixed emotions which Mikko is unable to shake away. Mikko tries to come out of his shell with his own way but everything ends up going even worse.

1729170.title: Unexposed
1729170.overview: Gunawan, a man widely admired for his kindness and impeccable reputation, is relentlessly pursued by a mysterious killer before ultimately meeting a brutal end. As the truth unfolds, however, it is revealed that the killer is not acting at random but is seeking revenge. Behind Gunawan's mask of virtue lies a sexual predator whose actions drove the killer's younger sister to take her own life. Shielded by his wealth, influence, and social standing, Gunawan escaped legal consequences. In the end, the mysterious killer becomes the one who delivers the justice that the law failed to provide.

1731474.title: The Dulling

1731474.trailerName: The Dulling (teaser) - a short film releasing July 15th

1734738.trailerName: TRIPLE DECKER | Official Trailer | Feature Film (2026)

1734866.title: Wirbel
1734866.overview: A dilapidated house stands among the fields in the rolling landscape of the Czech Central Mountains. As the landscape resists and an ancient danger hidden in the soil comes to life, Martin must restore the lost memory of the place to save Agnes, the land, and himself.

1735378.title: National Theatre at Home: London Road

The occupant of No. 79 London Road is arrested, charged and finally convicted of the murders. Caught in the headlines and the invasion of their quiet road, the community grapples with what it means to be at the epicentre of the tragedy. Using their own words set to an innovative musical score, London Road is a moving story of ordinary people coming together during an extraordinary time. Director Rufus Norris, writer Alecky Blythe, and composer Adam Cork reunite for this highly anticipated return of the remarkable, award-winning verbatim musical.
1735378.trailerName: London Road Exclusive Clip | National Theatre at Home

1736466.title: Bakom Svärtan

The series is based on the book *Sommaren 1985* by John Ajvide Lindqvist, a master at blending Swedish realism with the supernatural. Behind the scenes, an intensive effort is underway to create the mermaid and make her look authentic.

1742290.overview: Upcoming short film made in collaboration with Bus Stop Films participants.

After throwing it away, the box inexplicably returns  and with it comes a series of increasingly disturbing events. As Max begins to realise he may not be alone, he finds himself caught in a sinister cycle that has haunted the cabin long before he arrived.

1744786.title: Friendly Fire & Other Assorted Songs
1744786.overview: William JOSÉ unwittingly attracts vultures. Disgusted, he hitches his belongings to a trailer and sets off, but an accident interrupts his escape. Unable to continue his journey, he must confront the beasts pursuing him in a tumultuous and revealing conflict.

1744850.title: A River of Blues

1746770.title: 100 Years of Route 66
1746770.overview: Many people have Route 66 on their bucket list: To ride it once, from Chicago to Los Angeles, on a Harley. Or in an old American road cruiser. And experience what we know from the movies: the endless expanse of the plains, the endless deserts with their shimmering red mesas, the small-town USA. Even after 100 years, Route 66 stands for freedom and adventure, the promise of happiness in the USA. But it also stands for the many people who live along Route 66 but are not part of its history. And thus for the USA itself and its contradictions.

1747346.title: Michelle's Mobile Medium
1747346.overview: When a hopelessly romantic spiritual medium meets her next hot catch (and client), she soon learns that this time, the story really isn't her new future with her client as much as it is his past.

1747730.title: Blindspot Berlin
1747730.overview: The investigation and its shortfalls in the months before the December 2016 attack at the Christmas market at Breitscheidplatz, Berlin.

1748498.overview: Stories about a small town and its people who use cameras to capture images in hopes of preserving them. A film about how cinema becomes a repository of memory.

1751122.trailerName: Trailer CHOP BREAKFAST Uzor Arukwe, Taye Arimoro Afeez Oyetoro, Funke TINUBU

1751698.title: We Will Be Together

Tasked with testing the technology and reporting any issues before returning it within five days, he begins to experience something he has never had before: genuine companionship. As the AI learns his habits, anticipates his needs, and becomes increasingly devoted to him, their connection begins to blur the line between assistance and obsession. When he starts forming a new relationship outside of the AI’s control, the companion’s programming takes a darker turn.
1751698.trailerName: WE WILL BE TOGETHER | Official Trailer

As they navigate fatherhood, loss, and those who came before, the film becomes an intimate portrait of generations caught between violence and purpose, survival and legacy.

1773266.overview: Billie (Anderson) is a workaholic realtor who heads home for Christmas but her journey is derailed after a loveable but chaotic canine named Yappy almost causes her car to crash. After talking to Yappy's owner, the mysterious yet oddly familiar Mrs. C, Billie agrees to watch Yappy while she visits her grandchildren for the holidays. Yappy ends up playing the role of matchmaker and new best friend, pulling Billie towards her traveling contractor ex-boyfriend from high school, Hutch (Harding). Eager to move on, she's determined to leave Hutch in the past, but when her mother hires him to work on their shed, she finds herself spending more time with him than she ever expected. As the holidays draw closer, Billie begins to question whether chasing her dream of becoming her firm's number one seller is truly what she wants. When the mysterious Mrs. C leaves her cabin for Billie and Hutch to breathe new life into, her answer may come sooner than expected.
